message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India (Projected / Estimated)**  

| Item | Details | Approx. Cost (INR) |
|------|---------|--------------------|
| **Base Model (Long‑Range)** | 2024 Model S Long‑Range (standard‑range battery, dual‑motor AWD) | ₹1.5 – 1.7 crore |
| **Performance Model** | 2024 Model S Performance (dual‑motor AWD, 0‑60 mph in ~2.5 s) | ₹1.8 – 2.0 crore |
| **Optional Upgrades** | Full Self‑Driving (FSD) package, premium interior, etc. | +₹10 – 15 lakhs |

> **Why the estimate?**  
> • Tesla has **not yet launched** in India, so there is no official MSRP.  
> • The price above is derived from the U.S. MSRP (~$90k–$110k) plus:  
>   – Import duty (15 % on the vehicle value)  
>   – GST (18 % on the vehicle value + duty)  
>   – Additional state taxes (up to 6 %)  
>   – Logistics & handling fees (~₹5–10 lakhs)  
>   – Currency conversion (USD → INR at ~₹82–₹85 per $1).  

**Bottom line:** If Tesla were to launch in India, you could expect a Model S to cost roughly **₹1.5–2 crore** (≈ $18k–$24k). Keep an eye on official announcements—Tesla’s pricing strategy may change once they enter the Indian market.
